title: Complexity Theory
description: Some problems are hard to solve but easy to check: given a certificate, a verifier can confirm a solution in polynomial time even when finding one may take exponential time (NP). Whether every such problem is also easy to solve (P = NP) is the great open question. A zero-knowledge proof convinces a verifier, round by round, that a certificate exists without showing it. Unlocks the Certificate Verifier: Zero-Knowledge Proofs and Grover Oracles.

puzzle.goal: In each round of an interactive proof a cheating prover is caught with probability one half. Write the chance ε that a cheat survives k rounds.
puzzle.name: Soundness of an interactive proof
puzzle.method: The rounds are independent: the cheat must be lucky every time.
